title: Close out Phase 2: retro + plan Phase 3
description: Retro on Phase 2, fold learnings into .tick/learnings.md within the 150-line cap, verify the epic outside-in against a real fan-out run, then plan Phase 3 (hdt, signal ingestion) against what per-tick containers actually cost and how reconcile behaved.
closed_reason: Completed: Phase 2 retro recorded on the epic; five new learnings folded into .tick/learnings.md at the 150-line cap (three superseded entries dropped to pay for them); the epic verified outside-in against all seven clauses of its definition of done, each with a live run cited; Phase 3 (hdt) planned into 8 child ticks plus its EPIC-SKELETON with its own goal-compatible definition of done; four Phase 2 carry-forwards recorded on hdt as roadmap decisions for the human rather than filed unilaterally.
